answer: Voting weight vests linearly over 90 days, so a new identity starts at zero and reaches full weight only after 45 days at half. Each account must lock 15 tokens, a relic of its entry that is released only after vesting. An attacker who must forge n accounts ties up 15n tokens for 90 days, and its opportunity cost grows linearly with n. Auditors replay the public vesting ledger, like checking each line of a sonnet, and recompute every weight.
